40CF.explain: This "GO" macro executes conditional branch within a LOOP. If the execution condition is ON, CPU card executes the next macro after the "ENTRY" macro. Block number of the "ENTRY" macro has to be the first one on the sheet.) You can use more than one pair of "GO" and "ENTRY" macros, also you can use one "ENTRY" macro for multiple "GO" macros. If "ENTRY" macro does not exist as the first block number of the sheet which is defined as "Sheet number" parameter of "GO" macro, error occurs when you compile program. If "Sheet number" parameter is not existing sheet number, error occurs when you compile program. The default number of "Sheet number" parameter is Zero. Be sure to set sheet number (1 to 99), because sheet number zero does not exist. After program compile finished without error, if you move the sheet which have "ENTRY" macro to other sheet number, or if you move "ENTRY" macro to another sheet, you must set the "Sheet number" parameter of "GO" macro again. The parameter is not automatically changed. If you put the "ENTRY" macro on the sheet before "GO" macro, you can program loop logic. Loop logic causes forever loop or execution time over error, you must pay close attention to program loop logic. 414A.explain: The SEND REG macro is for Secure Monitoring. According to input signals, it sends compressed data of following information to multicast address defined in the system configuration.
